sovereign_country.strategic_role: 支持全中文章程、传统华人客群离岸家族信托常驻地

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Fiduciary Administration of Irrevocable Offshore Spendthrift Trusts

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Samoa (Offshore Financial Centre; administered by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour and the Central Bank of Samoa)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Common Law (English common law heritage, as modified by Samoan statutes and customary Fa'a Samoa principles)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Double Taxation Agreement between Samoa and Australia (signed 2008, in force 2009)
Double Taxation Agreement between Samoa and New Zealand (signed 2010, in force 2011)
Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEAs) in force with multiple OECD and non-OECD jurisdictions

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act 2004 (as amended, including beneficial ownership registration amendments), International Trusts Act 2004, Beneficial Ownership Act 2017, Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 (as amended), Financial Intelligence Unit Regulations 2008, and AML/CFT directives and risk-based supervision guidelines issued by the Central Bank of Samoa

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Certificate of Incorporation of International Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa (Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Samoa is not a party to the Hague Apostille Convention of 1961; chain authentication via the Samoa Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade and the relevant consulate)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association (certified by the licensed registered agent)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed Registered Agent / Notary Public, Samoa
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (through Samoa Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade and relevant consulate)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Certificate of Beneficial Ownership / UBO Register Extract
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed Registered Agent (confidential government-access register under the International Companies Act 2004 and Beneficial Ownership Act 2017)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (restricted disclosure protocol; extract issued for AML/CFT due diligence and government requests only)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence for politically exposed persons under the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 and Central Bank of Samoa AML/CFT directives; mandatory screening of all settlors, protectors, beneficiaries, and authorised officers against UN Security Council consolidated sanctions, OFAC SDN list, EU consolidated financial sanctions list, and the Samoa domestic sanctions list administered by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade; ongoing transaction monitoring and mandatory suspicious transaction and terrorist financing reporting to the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU).

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoan International Companies Registry (MCIL Business Registry; name clearance submitted through a licensed registered agent to the Registrar of International Companies)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory corporate name must be in English characters; no non-Latin transliteration (including Chinese characters) has statutory effect, although a Chinese-language translation of the articles may be maintained for client convenience without registry effect; the name must not be identical or confusingly similar to any existing local or international company; the name must end with a limited-liability suffix, e.g., 'Limited', 'Ltd.', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Inc.', or 'Corp.'; where the entity acts as trustee, the name should clearly reflect trust-related activity and must obtain prior regulatory endorsement from the Registrar of International Companies.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within 14 calendar days of the written rejection notice from the Registrar of International Companies, the applicant (through its licensed registered agent) shall file a Notice of Administrative Appeal addressed to the Chief Executive Officer of the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour; the Registrar is required to render a written decision within 21 working days of the appeal; a further de novo judicial appeal lies to the Supreme Court of Samoa within 30 days of the administrative decision.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not accepted. The International Companies Act 2004 and the International Trusts Act 2004 require a physical registered office in Samoa maintained by a licensed registered agent or licensed trustee company; virtual-office-only or mail-forwarding-only arrangements do not satisfy the statutory registered-office requirement, particularly for a discretionary asset-protection trust administration license.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High: 85% - Given the high-risk AML/CFT special license tier for discretionary asset-protection trust administration, the Central Bank of Samoa and the Registrar of International Companies conduct unannounced on-site inspections on a risk-based cycle, typically within the first 18 months after licensing and annually thereafter; malpractice history or sanctions-list triggers may elevate frequency.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and availability search fee (International Company)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the International Companies (Fees) Regulations 2004

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: International Company incorporation filing fee (nil or nominal capital)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the International Companies (Fees) Regulations 2004

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government certification and stamp duty on certificate of incorporation
First-year licensed registered agent fee and physical registered office mandate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Registered Agent (Samoa), holding a valid license under the International Companies Act 2004
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark among Samoan corporate service providers

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT UBO due diligence, PEP screening, and OFAC/UN/EU sanctions screening (per settlor, protector, and discretionary beneficiary)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark under Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 and Central Bank of Samoa directives

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Discretionary asset-protection trust administration special license vetting and filing fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Central Bank of Samoa / Registrar of International Companies
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the International Trusts Act 2004 and applicable FIU licensing directives

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and consular legalization bundle (certificate of incorporation, memorandum and articles, UBO extract, and certificate of good standing)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Samoa Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade / Relevant Consulate / Notary Public
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Consular legalization tariff and prevailing notarial fee benchmark

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (No. 10 of 1987), ss. 4-12 and ss. 13-20; as supplemented by the International Trusts Act 2011 for fiduciary licensing obligations and the Samoa AML/CFT Act 2016
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), Companies Registry Department, Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association together with SIFA Form IC-002 'Statement of Particulars on Incorporation of an International Company'
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital. The Act permits incorporation with one or more shares of no par value, subscribed in any currency; no bank escrow, capital deposit receipt or solvency certificate is required at the incorporation stage. However, to perform fiduciary trust administration, SIFA expects a minimum issued paid-up capital of approximately USD 2,000 equivalent as an eligibility condition for the International Trust Entity Licence.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the Company accepts subscription of the founding shareholder for one ordinary share of no par value, consideration to be credited as paid. RESOLVED that the registered office be fixed at the licensed agent's address in Apia, Samoa, and that any change be notified to the Registrar. RESOLVED that [Name A] and [Name B] are appointed first directors, [Name C] Secretary, and [Name D] AML Compliance Officer, each to act under the International Companies Act 1987. RESOLVED that the directors open a fiduciary trust bank account and execute all filings for the International Trust Entity Licence.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-incorporation name reservation and risk screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SIFA Companies Registry, Apia, Samoa; online via SIFA e-Registration portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit SIFA Form IC-001 'Application for Reservation of Company Name' providing at least two proposed names. Authorise the licensed Samoan registered agent to conduct a conflict search and unlawful-objects check against the SIFA names index. Pay the name reservation fee and obtain a 30-day name protection certificate.
required_dossiers: SIFA Form IC-001 – Name Reservation Application
Certified copy of passport or identification of the proposed ultimate beneficial owner
Consent letter from the licensed Samoan registered agent
Proof of payment of the name reservation fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected as undesirable, confusingly similar, or containing prohibited bank/trust terms, file an amended Form IC-001 with alternative names; resubmission is processed within 2 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, vetting and notarization of constitutional documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed International Trust and Company Service Provider in Samoa and a Notary Public / Commissioner for Oaths
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Have the registered agent draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English, specifying the permitted object of fiduciary administration, offshore spendthrift trust services, investment holding, indemnity clauses, share authority, and prohibition against carrying on domestic business. Execute the documents before a Notary Public or Commissioner for Oaths and arrange for the proposed directors and secretary to sign their consents.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum of Association
Draft Articles of Association
Consent to act as director from each proposed director
Consent to act as secretary from the proposed secretary
Identity documents and business reference for the corporate shareholder, if any
Written undertaking of the registered agent to maintain the registered office in Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the Registrar queries the objects or the expression of authorised capital, the registered agent amends the M&A and re-executes the signatures against every alteration; the amended document is treated as a fresh submission and appended to the application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory application and payment of filing fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the signed original Memorandum and Articles of Association, SIFA Form IC-002 Statement of Particulars, Form IC-003 Consent of Registered Agent, statutory declaration as to solvency, and appointment of first directors. Pay the official state incorporation fee of USD 100 and the first-year annual fee by SWIFT transfer to SIFA's account, and retain the stamped acknowledgement receipt.
required_dossiers: SIFA Form IC-002 – Statement of Particulars
Signed original Memorandum and Articles of Association
SIFA Form IC-003 – Consent of Registered Agent
Statutory declaration of solvency by a director or authorised agent
Receipt for the USD incorporation fee and first-year government fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SIFA issues a defect notice for omitted notarization, missing consent, or unpaid fees, all corrective documents must be lodged within 14 days; failure to cure within this window results in deemed withdrawal, requiring a fresh application with updated fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registry validation, company numbering and Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Registrar examines the application for compliance with the International Companies Act 1987, assigns a unique International Company number, records the registered office and first directors in the register, and issues a sealed Certificate of Incorporation together with a certified copy of the M&A. The company becomes a legal person on the date and time stated in the certificate.
required_dossiers: Complete application file bearing the SIFA lodgement stamp
Government fee receipt and payment confirmation
Name reservation certificate issued under step 1
Filed copy of the registered agent's consent and undertaking
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where issuance is delayed beyond the SLA, lodge a written expedite request with SIFA; if still unresolved, apply to the Registrar under the Act for rectification or a certificate of good standing to prove incorporation status.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First board meeting and statutory registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered office of the Company in Apia, Samoa, supervised by the licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or pass a unanimous written resolution: confirm subscription of the subscriber share, adopt the registered office, appoint directors, secretary and AML Compliance Officer, authorise bank account opening, and ratify any pre-incorporation contracts. The secretary opens the register of members, register of directors and secretaries, register of charges, and minute book, and files any required post-incorporation returns within 14 days.
required_dossiers: First board minutes or unanimous written resolution
Share certificate issued to the founding shareholder
Register of members, directors and secretaries
Registered office address confirmation and agent's consent
AML compliance manual and appointment form for the compliance officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar or SIFA notes that the AML compliance officer is not appointed or the statutory registers are incomplete, cure the defect by passing a supplementary board resolution and filing an updated Form IC-002 within 5 business days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) – Licensing and Supervision Division
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: International Trust Entity Licence for Trustee and Fiduciary Administration under the International Trusts Act 2011 and accompanying SIFA AML/CFT licensing directive

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE); Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA) for land-use and minor activity clearance
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category D – Non-scheduled administrative service. Mandatory EIA registration is waived for office-based trust fiduciary operations; a Minor Activity Certificate or, where physical fit-out exceeds thresholds, an Environmental Management Plan is required. No full EIA Report is required unless dedicated industrial facilities or generator plants are installed.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: The office use is exempt from process wastewater and stack emission standards. Where standby diesel generators or HVAC cooling equipment exist, exhaust emissions must meet MNRE ambient air quality guidelines; waste oils and e-waste must be stored in bunded containment and removed by an SIFA-licensed waste contractor. Any incidental trade effluent or sanitary discharge must comply with Samoa National Water Quality Standards of BOD5 < 30 mg/L, TSS < 50 mg/L, and pH 6.5-8.5 before discharge.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Occupancy Permit and Fire Safety Certificate from the National Fire Services Authority (NFSA); structural load inspection certification from the Ministry of Works, Transport and Infrastructure (MWTI) for the dedicated office floor; and annual workplace safety clearance under the Occupational Safety and Health Act 2011 covering fire evacuation drills, first aid equipment, electrical safety inspection, and seismic stability of the registered office.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Samoa Revenue Authority (SRA), Ministry of Finance; online portal: https://www.sra.gov.ws
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity or non-resident company must register with the SRA through the Business and Taxpayer Registration Unit on the official IR-1 Business Registration form, accompanied by the certificate of incorporation, registered agent certificate, constitutional documents or trust deed, and valid identification of directors/trustees. The SRA issues a Tax Identification Number (TIN) and, where taxable supplies in Samoa are made, a VAGST registration number within approximately 10 business days. International Companies that do not undertake taxable activities in Samoa are statutorily exempt and are not ordinarily required to obtain a TIN solely for offshore operations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election mechanism is available under Samoa law. An International Company is tax-exempt by statute where its business is conducted outside Samoa; no elective entity-classification regime exists.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: SAT 60,000 (approximately USD 22,000) of taxable turnover per annum
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Samoa has no real-time fiscal clearance, API e-invoicing, or digital stamping mandate. Taxpayers must issue VAGST invoices, retain source documents, and file monthly VAGST returns electronically through the SRA online portal.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to goods exported from Samoa within 28 days of supply, and to services provided to non-resident customers supplied and used entirely outside Samoa, provided the supplier is a registered VAGST person and retains documentary evidence proving the exportation or offshore consumption.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: SRA audits zero-rated export claims; fraudulent or excessive zero-rating claims attract a shortfall penalty of up to 150% of the tax evaded, late-payment penalties and interest, retrospective clawback of input credits, and criminal prosecution including fines and imprisonment. Directors and trustees may be held jointly and severally liable for such penalties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (Faletupe Tutotonu o Samoa) — the Foreign Exchange Administration with statutory authority for banking licensing, monetary policy, and exchange-control administration under the Central Bank of Samoa Act 1984 and the Financial Institutions Act 1996.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan Tala (WST) is a non-internationally traded, managed currency pegged to a basket of major trading-partner currencies; practical convertibility is delivered solely through CBS-licensed authorised dealers and their correspondent/nostro networks. Current-account payments (imports, services, fiduciary fees, dividends) are available on an expedited basis with documentary retention, while capital-account movements (capital injections, onward loans, portfolio flows, and capital repatriation) require prior CBS exchange-control approval or a standing exemption certificate. Profit remittance from a tax-exempt International Company is permitted once the entity holds a tax-goodstanding/offshore-status certificate; the principal practical hurdle is WST conversion, not dividend legality. The recommended treasury posture is therefore a fully foreign-currency (USD/EUR) structure that transits no WST clearing account and keeps all onshore exposure de minimis.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under Samoa's exchange-control regulations, a resident exporter must repatriate export receipts to a CBS-licensed authorised dealer in Samoa no later than 90 days from the date of shipment and must surrender the full 100% of the WST-equivalent proceeds to the dealer unless the CBS has granted a foreign-currency retention account licence or a directed exemption. An International Company operating as a non-resident offshore fiduciary falls outside the surrender mandate where its banking relationship is expressly designated 'non-resident' and no goods pass through Samoan customs or the domestic clearing rail; however, any trust income that is remitted into a WST-denominated resident account will be captured as ordinary exchange receipts and subjected to the 90-day reporting and conversion discipline. Treasury policy must therefore maintain a CBS-acknowledged standing non-resident exemption reference and prohibit inadvertent WST crediting.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Non-resident USD/EUR foreign-currency Capital Escrow Account (treasurer-designated)

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: BSP (Samoa) Limited (Bank of South Pacific, successor to Westpac Samoa)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Non-resident USD Foreign Currency Trust Settlement / Operational Account
Operational Account with dual WST/USD ledger and sub-escrow designation
Multicurrency Capital Escrow Account and Fiduciary Trust Settlement Account (USD/EUR/AUD)

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Renewal Application and Annual Government Fee for an International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies / Samoa International Financial Services Authority (SIFA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary date of incorporation; if the anniversary falls on a non-business day, the next business day in Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment incurs a monthly penalty of 10% of the unpaid fee for each commenced month of arrears. Continued non-payment for up to 12 months places the company on the administrative strike-off list; the Registrar may dissolve the company after the required warning notice is served on the registered agent and the company.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation and Share Transfer Compliance Declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered Agent on behalf of the Registrar of International Companies / SIFA
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 calendar days after the anniversary of incorporation, covering the preceding 12-month period; any share transfer must be separately notified to the registered agent within 14 days of transfer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file the confirmation blocks the annual renewal process, triggers a written default notice, and may subject the company and each director to a monetary penalty not exceeding WS$500 per month of violation. Persistent default for more than 9 months permits the Registrar to initiate deregistration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Renewal of Trust Business Licence for a Licensed International Trust Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually before 31 January for a licence issued on a calendar-year basis, or one month before the licence anniversary for licences issued mid-year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-renewal results in automatic suspension of the trust business licence, a penalty of up to 500 penalty units, and potential revocation of the licence for continued non-compliance. Directors and the licensed trustee may also become subject to disqualification under the International Trusts Act 2012.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A standard International Company is not subject to a compulsory annual audit unless it is a licensed trustee under the International Trusts Act 2012, or unless total consolidated assets exceed SAT 1,000,000 or annual gross revenue exceeds SAT 500,000, or the Registrar or SIFA directs an audit in the public interest. A licensed trust company must submit audited financial statements to SIFA whenever the audit requirement is stated as a condition of the trust licence.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as adopted for use in Samoa; alternatively, New Zealand or Australian GAAP as approved by the registered agent where the financial statements are prepared solely for management or regulator purposes.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The resident registered agent must maintain a current register of beneficial owners at the registered office in Samoa. Every transfer of shares in the International Company is effective only when entered in the Register of Members; the registered agent must be notified within 14 days. Annually, the registered agent submits a compliance confirmation to SIFA stating that the UBO register is accurate and disclosing all shareholding transfers and changes in beneficial ownership during the prior 12 months. Failure to confirm is a statutory offence and blocks the company's annual renewal.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 850–1,500 per annum for licensed registered office and resident licensed registered agent services in Apia
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,000–6,000 for a licensed trust company requiring a certified audit; nil for an ordinary exempt international company with no statutory audit obligation

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Companies are statutorily exempt from income tax, capital gains tax, dividend withholding tax, and stamp duty under Sections 198-203 of the International Companies Act 1988. Effective tax rate on offshore business is 0%.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: International Company Annual Return (Form IC-AR) filed under Section 243 of the International Companies Act 1988 via the Samoa Registrar of International Companies (Ministry of Commerce, Industry, Labour and Immigration; electronic filing through the International Companies Registration Office portal).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 60 days after each anniversary of the date of incorporation, together with payment of the annual government fee.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in Samoa (must be the office of the licensed international company agent).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide the exact street address of the licensed Samoan registered agent; a P.O. Box alone is not sufficient for validation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and licence number of the licensed International Company Agent providing the registered office and compliance functions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A licensed Samoan resident agent is mandatory for every International Company; the agent must be identified and its licence number stated.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised share capital and issued shares, including number, par value, and currency.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare the full equity structure; bearer shares must be eliminated or surrendered to a regulated custodian.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Register details of directors and shareholders.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Full legal names, residential addresses, and beneficial ownership must be recorded; beneficial ownership may be filed in a confidential annex but must be accessible to the AML regulator.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax-exemption declaration confirming the International Company is not carrying on business in Samoa.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm no domestic Samoan business is conducted; the company relies on the absolute income tax exemption under the International Companies Act 1988.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of WS$200 plus a 10% surcharge on the annual government fee for each month of continued default; persistent non-filing triggers automatic strike-off and dissolution; restoration requires payment of all arrears and a restoration fee; directors and the registered agent are jointly liable.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Economic Substance Declaration (Form ES-1) under the International Companies (Economic Substance) Regulations 2021, submitted to the Samoa Registrar of International Companies through the electronic filing portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within nine months after the end of the annual accounting period; for a December fiscal year-end, on or before 30 September of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: International Company identification number, name, and date of incorporation; registered agent details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the IC number exactly as registered; indicate the agent's licence number and confirm the agent is not struck off.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Relevant activity category claimed under the Economic Substance Regulations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For fiduciary administration of offshore spendthrift trusts, select 'Fund Management' or 'Headquarters Service Centre' as applicable to the actual operations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Nature and quantum of gross income relating to the relevant activity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose fee income from trust administration; if all income is derived from sources outside Samoa and no local business is conducted, state zero Samoan-source income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Core income-generating activities carried on in Samoa.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Describe the local board meetings, local management decisions, and contract controls physically carried out in Samoa; vague statements will be rejected.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Economic substance indicators: physical premises, locally resident employees, and local operating expenditure.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Quantify the registered office, number and qualifications of local employees, and annual Samoan operating expenditure; records must be retained for at least six years.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Fines up to WS$100,000 for failure to file or for false declarations, plus a daily penalty of WS$1,000 during the period of non-compliance; the declaration is exchanged with the competent authorities of OECD/EU jurisdictions; licences of the registered agent may be revoked and the International Company may be struck off.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 15% under the Income Tax Act 2015 for dividends sourced from Samoa; effective rate is 0% for dividends declared by an International Company due to the statutory exemption under the International Companies Act 1988.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: A non-resident recipient invoking a double taxation agreement must submit a completed treaty relief form (DWT-REL) to the Samoan resident payer accompanied by: (i) a valid Certificate of Tax Residence issued by the tax authority of the treaty jurisdiction; (ii) a beneficial ownership declaration; and (iii) a shareholder ownership breakdown. The Samoa Ministry of Revenue serves as the Competent Authority and may require the payer to retain the documentation for five years. Treaty rates apply only where the Samoa International Company is not already relying on its absolute statutory exemption.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding on gross royalties and debt interest sourced from Samoa is 15% each; treaty rates are typically 10% for both royalties and interest under the Samoa-Australia DTA and the Samoa-China DTA; payments made by an International Company in respect of its offshore fiduciary business remain outside the Samoan tax net under the International Companies Act 1988.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory Local File or Master File regime has been codified for tax-exempt International Companies; Samoa's Income Tax Act 2015 applies the OECD arm's length principle to resident taxpayers generally. Administrative benchmark: WS$1,000,000 in annual cross-border related-party dealings triggers a requirement to maintain contemporaneous documentation if the exemption is challenged. An Economic Substance Declaration is mandatory for all International Companies regardless of transaction value.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable. The International Companies (Economic Substance) Regulations 2021 impose an economic substance test on Samoa International Companies carrying on 'relevant activities'. Fiduciary administration of irrevocable offshore spendthrift trusts is characterised as fund management or headquarters/service centre activity. The company must demonstrate a physical office in Samoa, locally resident directors or managers with adequate expertise, sufficient number of qualified local employees, adequate local operating expenditure, and core income-generating activities conducted in Samoa. Substance declarations are shared with OECD and EU authorities under the framework on harmful tax practices.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax evasion / sham trust and offshore concealment
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the discretionary asset protection trust and the Samoa International Company as a façade to conceal taxable income or beneficial ownership while the settlor retains effective control through reserved powers, unfettered distribution authority, or instruction-based trustee conduct without independent discretion.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Reassessment of the entire structure's income at the 27% corporate rate, penalties up to 100% of the tax evaded, late payment surcharges, and formal strike-off of the International Company; the trust assets may be subjected to tracing orders and anti-avoidance rulings under the Income Tax Act 2015.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Piercing the corporate veil: directors are jointly and severally liable for civil restitution of diverted trust assets, subject to travel bans while investigations are pending, and may face imprisonment of up to seven years for fraudulent disposition.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell company and absence of economic substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Filing the annual Economic Substance Declaration while the International Company has no physical presence in Samoa, no locally resident staff, no local board meetings, and no accounting records kept at the registered office.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine up to WS$100,000 plus a daily penalty of WS$1,000 for continued non-compliance; deregistration without prejudice to creditors; automatic exchange of information with the tax residence jurisdiction of the ultimate beneficial owner.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Civil restitution of penalties, disqualification of directors for up to five years, exclusion orders against foreign directors, revocation of the registered agent's licence, and personal liability of directors for unpaid penalties.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML / KYC deficiencies and unlicensed trust administration
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the fiduciary administration of irrevocable offshore spendthrift trusts without the required statutory special licence, failing to conduct customer due diligence on settlors and beneficiaries, or failing to file Suspicious Transaction Reports.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter Financing of Terrorism Act 2018, fines up to WS$1,000,000 for legal persons, confiscation of trust property and corporate assets, revocation of licences, and a prohibition on carrying on regulated financial activities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and trust officers are criminally liable when involvement is wilful; imprisonment of up to seven years for money laundering and up to fourteen years for terrorism financing; civil restitution orders and travel bans for foreign principals.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Non-filing and misdeclaration of annual returns and economic substance declarations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to submit the annual International Company return and the Economic Substance Declaration for two consecutive years, or material misrepresentation of substance indicators.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Automatic dissolution under Section 243 of the International Companies Act 1988; restoration requires payment of all government fees in arrears plus restoration costs; information is shared with OECD and EU authorities and the company may be permanently excluded from the preferential tax regime.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for government fees in arrears and for fraudulent trading where the company continued to transact after strike-off; disqualification orders, travel bans, and criminal fines apply to the directors and the licensed agent.
